echo_sets.name: Shadow of Shattered Dreams + Void Thunder + Reel of Spliced Memories
echo_sets.note: The collab-specific triple-Sonata setup: the 1-pc set grants Basic and Heavy Attack DMG whenever Rebecca applies Hack - Shifting, stacked with Electro DMG +10% and ATK +10% from the 2-pc pieces (Lingering Tunes can replace Reel of Spliced Memories). Adam Smasher grants her a unique effect and Crit Rate.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Buffs her general sub-DPS output and gives the next Resonator an ATK buff; strong pick for slotting her with any DPS.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Heavy Electro DMG buffs; a workable early-game option but weaker than the triple-Sonata setup.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Skull Thrasher + 1-pc Shadow of Shattered Dreams / 2-pc Void Thunder / 2-pc ATK set in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Reminiscence: Nightmare Adam Smasher in the main slot. Stack Crit and Electro DMG on the 4-cost and 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs, and aim for roughly 125% Energy Regen so her Resonance Liberation is ready each rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Skull Thrasher
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature (also rendered 'Bone Crusher' in some guides). 500 base ATK, 72% Crit DMG substat, Basic Attack DMG via its skill, and a team-wide ATK buff for 30s when Hack - Shifting is inflicted. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: One of the best standard 5-star pistols: high base ATK and Crit DMG with an unconditional ATK buff passive, plus All-Attribute DMG Bonus on Tune Break.

ranked_weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK, Crit Rate substat, unconditional ATK passive, and a Basic Attack DMG increase for the wielder.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Sub-DPS pistol: Crit Rate, extra Energy Regen, and a passive that buffs the next Resonator's ATK.

ranked_weapons.name: Novaburst
ranked_weapons.note: ATK-based 4-star; accessible 12% ATK buff triggered by dashing or dodging.

ranked_weapons.name: Pistols#26
ranked_weapons.note: ATK-based 4-star; grants ATK while taking no damage and heals the user when hit.

ranked_weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
ranked_weapons.note: ATK-based 4-star; extra ATK and Resonance Energy for smoother rotations.

ATK% on both; her kit scales with ATK.

profile.role_note: Hybrid sub-DPS/amplifier; swaps between Huntress (Crit DMG) and Guts (DEF-ignore) stances and hands the next Resonator All-DMG plus stacking Heavy Attack DMG buffs via her Outro turret.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: There is nothing to pull for — Rebecca was the free 5-star from the 3.4 Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collab, and collab characters rarely rerun (Game8 notes her reruns are expected to be rarer than other limited units). If you claimed her during the event, she's an excellent no-cost investment: a premium-tier sub-DPS who buffs any Heavy Attack DPS. If you missed her, there's no confirmed way to obtain her right now, so don't hold resources waiting.

members.name: Lucy
members.note: The main damage dealer; multiple debuffs, time-stop burst, and she upgrades Rebecca's turret via the Hack - Shifting synergy.

members.name: Rebecca
members.note: Off-field turret from her Outro plus All-DMG and Heavy Attack DMG buffs for whoever swaps in next.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Boosts Off-Tune efficiency so Tune Break triggers more often, while providing All-DMG Amplification to the team. Shorekeeper or Verina can substitute.

teams.name: Premium: Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye opens with Basic Attacks and Resonance Skill, then Liberation to deploy High Syntony Field. Switch to Rebecca via Outro: run three Basic Attacks in Guts stance, swap to Huntress with her Resonance Skill, hit max Forte for an empowered Heavy Attack, then cast Liberation (re-press twice to upgrade it). Finally swap to Lucy for her burst combo, then loop back to Mornye.

members.name: Jingran
members.note: One of the strongest Heavy Attack carries; easy rotations let him convert Rebecca's buffs into huge numbers.

members.name: Rebecca
members.note: Quick Concerto generation, Liberation time-stop with Stagnation, and Outro buffs that suit any Heavy Attack DPS.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit and damage buffs plus healing; barely needs field time.

teams.name: Alternative: Jingran + Rebecca + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper builds gauges and deploys Stellarealm, then Outro into Rebecca: three Basic Attacks in Guts stance, Resonance Skill into Huntress, two more Basic Attacks, empowered Heavy Attack, Liberation (re-press twice to upgrade), then Outro to Jingran for his full Liberation and Heavy Attack combo before looping.
